Forest Department Denies Permission for Mohanlal Film Shoot

The Kerala Forest Department has denied permission for the shooting of the upcoming Mohanlal-starrer 'Athimanoharam' at the Sabarimala temple. The Periyar Tiger Reserve deputy director stated that judicial and government orders prohibit commercial film shoots within wildlife sanctuaries, national parks, or tiger reserves. This decision comes amidst a row where a Kerala Minister reportedly banned movie shoots at Sabarimala days after the film had initially secured permission.
